Title: Reminder: Sabbat War Pre-Release Party in Atlanta this Sat. Everyone attending MUST read!!!

Messages.Author: Todd Banister
Messages.Body:
This is a reminder that coming up on Saturday - The Sabbat War Pre-Release
Party here in Atlanta!

Date of the event: Sat. Oct. 28th, 2000

Schedule of events:
Registration is: 11:30am with the events starting at noon.

1st Event: Demo of the Sabbat War. Come one - come all (regardless of
playing experience). Everyone attending this demo will receive a FREE Sabbat
War starter (randomly distributed). And yes, you will be able to trade these
starters among the registered players before the tourney. The only
stipulation is that the new starter deck MUST remain unopened before
trading. No peaking!

2nd Event: A 2-Round Limited Sabbat War tourney. Each table during the
tourney will consist of one each of the different Sabbat War starters.
Participants will use their sealed deck in round number one.

After this round, players will have the option of purchasing 3 boosters of
Sabbat War for $11 from the War Room. After time to tune the decks, round
two follows and then the finals for the top five players.

3rd Event: Camarilla vs. Sabbat battle. This will be a single round battle
for supremacy between the sects for the city of Atlanta. Each player needs
to bring two constructed decks: One based on the Camarilla and one based on
the Sabbat. You will not know which sect you will represent until the event.

Depending on time, this event might go two rounds - this will be determined
at the beginning of this event.

The deck construction guidelines are the normal DCI tournament rules with
the following addition:
Camarilla Deck - At least half of your crypt must contain Camarilla only
vampires and you may include Independent vampires to round out the deck. You
may not include any Sabbat vampires in your crypt.

Sabbat Deck - At least half of your crypt must contain Sabbat only vampires
and you may include Independent vampires to round out the deck. You may not
include any Camarilla vampires in your crypt.

If you do not have any constructed decks, you may use the Sabbat War
starter.

As the round progresses, I will give updates as to how many VPs each sect
has accumulated. Prizes will be handed out after the round has completed to
the representatives of the winning sect. Individual prizes will also be
handed out to the players with the most VPs in the round.

Other news:
*** Update *** - Once again Steve Wieck has promised that he WILL BE
attending! Lets all give him a huge thanks for bringing our favorite game
back from the dead.

After the events, we can all head next door for beer and wings again (as
long as there is no karaoke!).

Directions to the War Room:
From Atlanta:
1.) Go 85 North until exit 38 which is Indian Trail Road.
2.) Take a left and cross back over the highway.
3.) Go through the first traffic light and you will pass an Arby's. 4.) Take
a short left into the strip shopping center right past Arby's. The shopping
center has a Winn Dixie in it and the War Room is next door.

The War Rooms phone number is (770) 729-9588. The address is 2055 Beaver
Ruin Road.

Don't miss out on your chance to get your hands on the awesome Sabbat War
cards before they are released to the public!

If you have any questions, please email me at T_Ban...@Premier-Lending.com
or (678) 742-1051.

Hope to see everyone there.

Todd Banister
Prince of Atlanta
Scribe of the Assamites
